suppress.notes: VULN-01 (Q-304, Q-314). Version confusion: Dependency-Check gives reactor-netty 1.3.x and Spring Boot's spring-boot-netty and spring-boot-reactor-netty 4.1.x the CPE cpe:2.3:a:netty:netty with their own version numbers, and every Netty advisory fixed in a 4.1.x release then matches. Neither jar contains Netty code: both depend on the io.netty:netty-* jars, which ship at 4.2.17.Final in the same boot jars and are scanned without any suppression. Checked on 2026-10-20: none of the 80 Netty CPE ranges in the report covers 4.2.17.

VULN-01 (Q-304, Q-314). Version confusion: grpc-netty-shaded 1.85.x is given cpe:2.3:a:netty:netty at the gRPC version 1.85.1, so every Netty advisory fixed in 4.1.x matches. The jar bundles Netty 4.2.17.Final (META-INF/io.grpc.netty.shaded.io.netty.versions.properties: netty-common.version=4.2.17.Final), the release of the io.netty jars in the same boot jars, which stay scanned without suppression, so a Netty advisory that covers 4.2.17 still fails the gate there. Checked on 2026-10-20: none of the Netty CPE ranges in the report covers 4.2.17. Re-check when grpc-java.version changes (root build SecurityPatches).

VULN-01 (Q-304). CVE-2026-33117 is in the local cryptography path of azure-security-keyvault-keys before 4.10.6 (NVD text: the Java Key Vault Keys library, addressed in version 4.10.6). Dependency-Check matches it to every Azure SDK artifact through the umbrella CPE cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:azure_sdk_for_java at the artifact's own version. The keyvault-keys jar itself ships at 4.11.3 (root build SecurityPatches) and is not covered by this entry; the artifacts listed here do not contain that code.

VULN-01 (Q-304). CVE-2023-36415 (Azure Identity SDK remote code execution) is fixed for Java in azure-identity 1.10.2 (NVD configuration cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:azure_identity_sdk with target software java, before 1.10.2). The services ship 1.11.0 and 1.11.1; the match comes from the JavaScript configuration of the same record (before 3.3.1), which Dependency-Check applies to the Java version.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Wrong product: CVE-2024-52338 is in the Apache Arrow R package and CVE-2026-25087 in Apache Arrow C++ (NVD texts). arrow-format, arrow-memory-core, arrow-memory-netty(-buffer-patch) and arrow-vector are the Java implementation (the BigQuery Storage read client brings them) and contain neither the R package nor the C++ library.

Wave-4B integration (Q-587). Wrong component: CVE-2026-111497 is an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder source c/dec/decode.c of Google Brotli 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 (NVD text). NVD lists it against the product cpe:2.3:a:apache:arrow up to 26.0.0 because the Arrow C++ build bundles that C library; Arrow has no fixed release, and the Java jars cannot hold the code. Checked on 2026-10-31 with the jars in the boot jars of da-autodelete (15.0.0), da-discovery and da-logingest (17.0.0): arrow-format, arrow-memory-core, arrow-memory-netty(-buffer-patch) and arrow-vector contain only Java classes, no native library or C source, and no class refers to Brotli (the IPC codecs of arrow-vector are LZ4 and Zstd). No Brotli jar is on the classpath of any boot jar. The one Brotli the images carry is the operating system package libbrotli1 of the distroless base, which Trivy scans and which the base image digest now pins at 1.1.0-2+deb13u1, the fixed package.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Wrong product: these OpenTelemetry advisories are for OpenTelemetry-Go (CPE target software go: CVE-2023-45142, CVE-2023-47108, CVE-2026-24051, CVE-2026-29181, CVE-2026-39883) and for the Python instrumentation (CVE-2023-43810, fixed in 0.41b0, a Python version). The matched jars are Java: the GCP exporter and resource detectors (com.google.cloud.opentelemetry) and the Java semconv and GCP resources modules, which the Google Cloud libraries bring.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Wrong product: CVE-2026-0994 is a recursion-limit bypass in google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict() of the Python protobuf package (NVD text). protobuf-java and protobuf-java-util are the Java runtime and hold no Python code; Dependency-Check compares the Java version 4.35.1 with the Python fix 33.4.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Wrong component: CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization of the Kotlin build cache metadata (NVD text), which is compiler and Gradle plugin code. kotlin-stdlib and its jdk7 and jdk8 companions are the runtime library (OkHttp and others bring it) and hold no build cache code. The match ends when the Spring Boot BOM moves kotlin.version to 2.4.20 or later.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Wrong product: CVE-2026-42154 is in the Prometheus server's remote read endpoint /api/v1/read (NVD text, fixed in Prometheus 3.5.3 and 3.11.3). micrometer-registry-prometheus is the Micrometer client that renders /actuator/prometheus; it has no remote read endpoint.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Wrong product: CVE-2009-2475, CVE-2009-2476, CVE-2009-2689 and CVE-2009-2716 are Sun Java SE 5 and 6 runtime flaws (CPE cpe:2.3:a:sun:java_se). Dependency-Check gives JNA (net.java.dev.jna, the native-access library) that CPE; the services run on the JDK 21 of the distroless base image.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Wrong product: CVE-2004-0455 is a buffer overflow in cgi.c of www-sql before 0.5.7 (CPE cpe:2.3:a:www-sql_project:www-sql). google-cloud-sql, proto-google-cloud-sql-v1 and -v1beta4 0.5.0 are the Java client and protos of the Cloud SQL Admin API; the name and the version 0.5.0 caused the match.

VULN-01 (Q-304). CVE-2018-1258 needs Spring Framework 5.0.5 together with Spring Security (NVD text: Spring Framework version 5.0.5 when used in combination with any versions of Spring Security). The services run Spring Framework 7.0.9 with Spring Security 7.1.1; the record lists every Spring Security version, which is why the Security jars match.

VULN-01 (Q-304). Version confusion: spring-shell-jline 4.0.3 (Spring Shell's JLine adapter) is given the CPE cpe:2.3:a:jline:jline at its own version, so JLine's CVE-2026-56740 and CVE-2026-56741 (remote-telnet, fixed in 3.30.14 and 4.0.16) match. The JLine jar itself ships at 3.30.17 (root build SecurityPatches) and is not covered by this entry.
